title: DeviceEvent
description: Canonical device event envelope used across the Smart Factory system.

device_id.description: Unique identifier for the device that generated the event.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (UTC) when the event occurred on the device.

id.description: Correlation ID matching the originating command id.

attempts.description: Number of transmission attempts before success or exhaustion.

sequence.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number from the bridge. Omit if unknown.

trace_id.description: Distributed trace identifier for correlating events across services.
